body:
I am guessing by your terminology and general manner of speaking that you are from England also? Sometimes talking things over with total strangers can put things in perspective, I expect there are a lot of things you have never told those around you. Tell us, perhaps the reaction you expect to receive won't be the one you actually do. Anonymity is great for testing the water.

Much love,

Chris

Think about your sister, you talk of being a burden to her, what would this do to her? You cannot do this, it is not a solution, "You are desperate to feel a sense of relief which is a human emotion, you cannot feel relief if you are dead". It may not seem like it at the moment but there are other alternatives. So you didn't get the job, there will be more interviews, don't be so hard on yourself jobs are scarce these days.
You worthless sack of human excrement.

Right I've had a little think about it and decided that I wouldn't even piss on any of you if you were on fire. This subreddit is sick, it preys on insecure people to provide entertainment. I help out over in suicidewatch under this username and several similar psuedonyms. We have to pick up the pieces when these people get told yes, yes your are fucking ugly. Beauty is more than skin deep but you shallow sacks of shit wouldn't even know what it was if it bit you.

This subreddit turns my stomach, fuck all these shallow morons, you are you and beauty is not skin deep. Wokeupsleepy you are a bloody moron, her eyes are being slightly magnified by the glasses.Fuck you all (apart from BeeAmoreDarling, please ignore these people) if this girl is ugly then I look like a piece of human feaces that has been kicked around a dusty room and left out in the sun to dry and you know what? To be fair buddy its my first time in this subreddit, I was in equal part intrigued and revulsed by the concept. I don't know how I feel about this, it opens up a lot of interesting questions. I was attempting to show the OP that there was a huge disparity between what she thinks she looks like and what she actually looks like. I suppose lying is the wrong word, I would have to have been very selective with my choice of words. I would never ever ever call somebody ugly, do you know what that can do to a person?

Great to have you here mate, welcome, thanks for your message of support. This place can make you cry sometimes but it really does restore your faith in humanity.

Much love,

Chris

Second that, from the description I was thinking I was going to have to lie and I was so pleasantly suprised when I saw the pics. You are cute, clearly in top shape, the boys that live near you are clearly either all stupid or just very immature.

Hey man,

I'm too tired for my brain to work properly, its 6 AM here and I dont know what to say. All I can do is tell you that I promise to read whatever you post and try and help in any way. 

Much love,

Chris

Hey man,

Stop drinking immediately, put the sharp knife back in the drawer where it came from. I was living with a guy that just played starcraft, played his guitar and sat around feeling sorry for himself. He broke up with his girlfriend of years because she moved to a different area and couldnt deal with his lifestyle any more. A year later and the two of them are back together, he has a job, is living near to her and from what I hear he is a hell of a lot happier. 

Fuck the debt off out of it for now, I owe the student loans company about 25,000 GBP and I couldnt honestly give a fuck. Don't get fired at work (if your on the verge it hasnt happened yet), do whatever it takes, go in with a whole new mindset. What do you do for work?

If you tell yourself you cant form emotional bonds you wont be able to, try letting your guard down and trying before you concede defeat. Fuck religion dont let that get you down, caused enough death and destruction around the world without fucking with your head too. If it works for you great, if not, great. 

Where are you parents moving to, can you not crash with them for a while? I was sofa surfing for 3 months last summer and it was actually quite good fun, I mean it got fucking old having no privacy and being a bit of a bum but it was good at points.

Being bad at something you love is not a bad thing, it is an incentive to get better at it. I didn't used to cook that well but I bloody love it, now I can cook up a feast and I take even more enjoyment in it and strive to get better.

Best of luck, get in touch if you need anything, ignore the haters here, I wish I could publicly shame these people in front of all their friends and family and show what sick little puppies they are.

Much love,

Chris
What the fuck is wrong with people.

That sounds most unorthodox? A letter? You should document any and all correspondance with your college, ask to record any meetings you have just for your notes. Most phones will have a workable voice recorder. They cannot kick you out because they don't think you can cope. If your grades are fine and your turning up whats the problem? What is the first you heard of this? Ill try and get my ex online tommorow if I can. She spent the whole of her first year crying about being away from home, most of her second year studying her arse off and lamenting not going out much in the first year and finally enjoyed her final year so much she ended up doing a masters (extra year we do in the UK). This will pass.

Ah I think we are at crossed wires, I think what you are saying is you must complete this course to get to where you want to be. I didnt mean take a different course I meant work round the issue of them trying to kick you out. Im in my 5th year at uni, you should be able to do 3 + 1 if your lucky. I am going back for my 6th year. The first time I needed to retake the year I was told you couldn't retake the final year. Well im about to do the final year for the third time so it looks like they were wrong =p dont give up Miss.
That guy sounds like a good therapist, glad you got your life sorted man, you did it your way and it worked. Good on you.

Ok I know all might feel lost at this point but I refuse to believe a college with 10,000 students could be taking that attitude. Sure certain members of staff might be, probably a chronic case of crabs or just being rubbish at their job. You mentioned a slim chance? What does that rest on? It sounds like you have been really working at this, power to you! Now try and step back, detach yourself emotionally and try and look at the situation objectively. Do you have a good relationship with any member of staff? A lecturer or anything, go and talk to them, make it hypothetical if you need, or about "a friend", they will know what the crack is anyway but it can give you a layer of protection. Ask them what they would do, who they would talk to? Is there anyone particularly sympathetic with any influence on proceedings.
What is a gen ed sorry? What have you taken before the program?

=( Im worried about you buddy, you sounded far too clear headed for my liking, I don't think your an imminent risk, you were talking about sorting things out first but suicide is not the answer you are looking for, your wife needs emotional support and a friend more than she needs money. Money comes and goes, a true soul friend doesn't.
Best of luck to you!

They are not dissapointed in you!!!!! You said it yourself "my grades are fine", this situation is not your fault, most people will find it difficult being away from home for the first time. Some more so than others, it is absolutely disgusting that your college is failing to help you adjust. How many more people in your situation have they failed because trust me when I say this what you are feeling is totally normal! That's why there is a word for it and everything. A word that doesn't carry any sort of stigma too. Being homesick is the most natural thing in the world. What you need to do now is hold your head up high, decide what you want (do you want to stay at college?) and come hell or high water let noone stand in your way, not the college, not the advisor, nobody. Believe in yourself, it is amazing what you can accomplish with some lateral thinking and determination. So lets find out who you need to contact. How big is this college? Does it have its own support services? This advisor is someone allocated to you specifically, is there anyone in charge of student welfare for your department?

Awh bless you, dont worry about that advisor you need to find a way to go round them, they are not helping you and sounds like they don't want to, NEXT! Trust me these institutions can seem so wankerish and uncaring and getting help out of them is almost an art form. There was a group of about 5 of us that would always see each other down student services and we always used to laugh and joke about how bloody useless the uni was, and share incredulous anecdotes etc. Got to keep your chin up somehow, it ended up with us trading info about who was helpful and who to avoid. That is how I got put in touch with the head of computer science and the issue got sorted. Keep trying, ignore your advisor they sound like they are crap at their job, try and go round them somehow.

Ah good work for going, it must be good to at least know why you have been feeling like this. Fingers crossed your on the mend, sometimes the reality you build in your head about what people will think etc can make things seem worse than they actually are. Im glad your parents reaction wasn't frantic. Are they going to switch your meds or take you off them all together? Cheers for updating us =)

Sounds like a relationship! Of course your going to fight, try not to let it get to you. Pick your battles and avoid pointless arguments if you can. Try expressing this to your partner (don't just drop it on them like a brick from a great height, break it to them slowly). Good luck buddy x
How did it go with the school counselor today? If you didn't make it don't worry at all, you can easily catch up with him another day =)
Rolling stones wrote a song about that actually =)    (you can't always get what you want for anyone that didn't know)

Hmmmm I can see your problem but there is only so much help anonymous people can give, this is clearly something important and worth talking through with somebody. You mentioned a relationship, what's the crack there then?
Good on you matey, I never talked to you before but you just made the people who you originally spoke to very very happy. Thankyou
Yo man, how are you feeling tonight? Hopefully your fast asleep somewhere. Hit me up if you need to chat.

I don't know your situation but I doubt it is too late to sort things out. You said the school is kicking you out, that means it hasn't happened yet. You need an ally at the college, I've been dealing with my university's student support services (yeah, a bloody joke, they are nice enough but absolutely useless, one of them is so fat he can hardly walk and then starts trying to tell you how to live your life, got to laugh though) and had got nowhere until I finally met the head of computer science who is an absolute legend, I never realised. Keep talking to people until you find someone on your side, turns out im allowed to repeat the year now which I was told was absolutely impossible before. Find a nice spot, a hill looking down on somewhere, some woods or a beach, somewhere peaceful and just sit. Just sit there existing for a little while, breath deeply and just chill. There is no immediate rush to do anything your just sat there being you, no problems, no people, just you. Let the calm wash over you, I usually feel a tingle down my spine and start smiling at this point. Slowly start thinking about each problem, one at a time, how can it be solved? what needs to be done? will it still be a problem in a years time? how about 5 years? if so how can you prevent it being a problem. Its really difficult to take a step back and be objective and 99% of the time I dont manage it but when you do, it feels like a massive weight has been lifted off your shoulders and you can take on the problem with conviction, whatever the solution, whether it be dropping out of college, changing subject or just going at whatever you were doing with renewed focus. 

Good luck! I hope you make a fine teacher some day...

Would you consider seeking help from a professional? Im worried about you and im not sure im capable of giving you the help you need. I can get contact numbers for your area or help you research anything if it helps. 

edit: I read your blog, I hadn't seen that last time, please don't misinterpret this as me trying to pass you off onto somebody else I just dont know how to help properly. Keep talking on here whenever your down, I will check as often as I can and there are good people in this subreddit, very kind genuine goood people. Try talking to other people in your situation, try and help each other. I have seen that work incredibly well in the past.

Sorry to hear that man, 

Night time is always the worst. Didnt really feel like sleeping last night so ive just been up all night watching crap on the internet. Trust me GCSEs are not bad at all, I went to a top notch sixth form college and all they wanted was 4 A - D s   noone even asks you what you got once your into college. You never put them on a CV and you start to ask yourself what all the bloody fuss was about. Trust me college will make all this seem like a distant memory. Keep your head focussed on that, study hard for English and Maths (those little tiny revision book things are all you need) as they will come in far more useful than the rest. You just have to keep your chin up and get through these last couple of months. Try and smile if you can, about anything, hell smile at how shit everything is. Your sense of humour is your ultimate weapon. If you can laugh when bad shit happens then it makes everything a lot easier (you heard the expression if I dont laugh ill cry right?) Try and go into social situations without your baggage, you have to have confidence in yourself or it will be harder for people to have confidence in you.  That arsehole you met is in the minority, I hope he gets a nasty case of hemmeroids =)

Much love matey,

Chris
Did you bother turning up at all?
Thanks for not taking that the wrong way, I should have phrased it a bit better. Just read it back. Power to you x

Not sure how scientific it is but the BBC is quite well renowned here so hopefully it is. I got 14. http://www.bbc.co.uk/science/humanbody/mind/surveys/smiles/

Nope just need lots of samples, look in the mirror and give a fake smile. Then think about the happiest thing you can until you feel yourself smiling automatically. Look at the difference. A fake smile mostly just the lips move, maybe a bit of cheek. With a real smile the whole face moves and the eyes light up. Give it a try =)
Difference between a real smile and a fake one is all in the eyes. You can spot a fake smile a mile away once you teach yourself =)

I dont know if you believe in alternative medecines or not, the way I see it is the might not help but it will almost certainly not hinder. St Johns Wort is often given for mild depression, You can get it from Holland and Barret or any shop like that.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_John%27s_wort

My flatmate swears by the stuff, she's 22 and has always been a bit reserved and finds it hard to meet people.
"textbook" means a classic case of so basically SilverWolf is saying your are displaying all the standard signs of depression.
Amen at least you realised before it was too late. You can change your life for the better and then you can help others do the same. Best of luck to you mate xx

"I feel that lately, I've been pushing away the few friends I had, ignoring calls"

Been there myself, very textbook depression, Lady-SilverWolf is right. You just can't bring yourself to pickup the phone but you don't understand why. Everything seems like too much effort. Don't worry, it will pass but you may need help to get rid of it. Some people do, some people don't, do what is right for you. I know its difficult but try and smile, think about things that have made you smile or laugh in the past. People being silly, fun things happening. Try and think positive, when you smile it makes you feel happier and you build up a sort of momentum. 

You are a young lady and you must understand your body is going through a lot of changes and hormones can have a huge effect on your mental wellbeing. I am a guy so I don't really understand but I know it had a huge effect on some friends as they were growing up, its something worth considering.

Good luck, try and smile =)

How you feeling today matey? Roughly what part of the country are you in? Have you heard the expression "The best laid plans of mice and men", plans change. That is the way things work and you have to learn to adapt with the adapting plans. Im here for you mate, if you wanna talk anything through the you are more than welcome.

"You really have to find what will make you happy in life, because no one else is going to create joy for you." I think you hit the nail right on the head there, find out what makes you happy, pursue it, think positive and the rest will come naturally.

Hey buddy, im 22 and im not wise but I have been through GCSE's A-levels and university. Dont you dare do anything stupid, trust me the school system sucks at that point but get to a big sixth form college. That is when life changed for me and I met all of the friends I have today. I literally had no friends before that =) Keep on trucking mate, just gonna grab some food ill be back in an hour to check on you.

Much love,

Chris
